query:
UPDATE bear_hat_access_grants g SET revoked_at = now()
         FROM user_bear ub
         WHERE g.bear_id = $1 AND g.hat_id = $2 AND g.id = $3
           AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
           AND ub.bear_id = g.bear_id AND ub.user_id = $4
           AND lower(btrim(coalesce(ub.role, ''))) = $5
         RETURNING g.id
